title: BUG: "Bolus reported an error. Manually check real delivery insulin and carb amount" on APPSClient 3.3.3.0-dev-c
body:
When using AAPSClient, the following error message appears:
"Bolus reported an error. Manually check real delivery insulin and carb amount"

However, no bolus was actually delivered on AAPSFull, and there were no microboluses at that time either.

 AAPSClient 3.3.3.0-dev-c

Logs sent.

comments.body: I didn't find this message in logs and no time was provided. Sorry
Error message is repeating. the next time, will send logs and time, sorry.
